title: Compose Plant access-grant administration in the PWA

gates.name: admin_plant_access_browser
gates.command: cd frontend && npm run test:e2e -- tests/e2e/admin-plant-access.spec.ts

verify: Independent grant browser verification covers list/create/update/revoke, approval-flag role constraints, archived administration, resulting Engineer selector access, and non-Boss denial.
evidence_required: FT-016-AC-015 RED: no Boss browser surface manages PlantAccessGrant; GREEN: exact grant list/create/update/revoke actions enforce target-role and approval-flag rules, remain administrable for archived Plant, and drive Engineer selector access only after backend commit; decisive comparison: request/response/DOM plus grant and Engineer-session reread; artifact: access-grant evidence under .tasks/TASK-098-T3-FT-016-W3/.
purpose: Expose Plant access-grant administration independently of Account role and Plant lifecycle implementation.
success_outcome: A Boss can manage an Engineer Plant grant and approval flag through backend authority while invalid/non-Boss/Consultant cases remain non-mutating and selector access follows the committed grant.
anti_goals: Do not create Accounts, assign roles, mutate Plant lifecycle, or derive permissions in the browser.
Do not grant Consultant action approval or treat approval flag as Safety clearance.

stop_conditions: Grant behavior needs a route or permission outside Plant Management HTTP.
The browser would need to infer access or bypass archived/current membership rules.

constraints: Primary owner is Operator PWA; Access & Admin owns grant, permission, and audit state.
Use exact membership/Plant identities and backend-returned permission summaries.
invariants: Frontend visibility never grants Plant access or action approval.
Rejected/retried grant commands leave one authoritative stable grant state.
verification_targets: FT-016-AC-015: exact grant lifecycle, approval-role constraints, archived administration, Engineer selector effect, and non-Boss denial.
T3 harm proof uses isolated memberships/Plants and confirms no unintended access, Safety authority, or duplicate grant effect after rerun.
